none: PAS LIN-58DCEA: LIN-58DCEA: Roman coin of H. of Constantine, nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, dating to AD 337-40 (Reece Period 17), GLORIA EXERCITVS, Two soldiers and one standard. Mint of Trier. Obverse description: Laureate, draped bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTIVS [...]. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse description: Two soldiers and one standard. Reverse mint mark: TRP. Diameter: 13.80 mm; Weight: 1.23g
